name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 39 – Am 99
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 39. Reaffirms Parliament’s priorities regarding expenditure reductions for the next budget year, which entail, in particular, not continuing to strengthen administrative support for Parliament or the “Green Parliament” project;
